commentary_segments.text: The other ‘‘most used’’ operational transconductance amplifier is the folded cascode OTA. Many designers limit themselves to folded cascode OTA’s only. It is therefore important to figure out what exactly the advantages and disadvantages are. Also, which design plan delivers the best performance in terms of power consumption, noise, etc.
